what.text: This page follows refugees from El Salvador living in Nicaragua, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2023, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 210 Salvadoran refugees in Nicaragua, 0.3% of all refugees from El Salvador that year.
The United States hosts the most Salvadoran refugees, followed by Mexico, Italy and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of El Salvador from 1979 to 1991, with the FMLN among the opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1981 to 1985, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1980 at 4000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 22740, at the end of 1982, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Nicaragua.
These are year-end totals for Nicaragua only, reported to UNHCR from 1980 to 2023.
